integrity: Complete analytic proof and self-contained numerical reproducer are included; the finite numerical checks are supplementary. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real symmetric positive-definite matrices, exact arithmetic, subspace embedding on the full next Krylov space; proves Ritz location only, not restarted convergence. The sharp angular inequality is classical. Historical priority is qualified.
title: Exact embedding-distortion frontier for positive sketched harmonic Ritz values
